title: Chapter 002
synopsis: A serene coffee shop, 'Senja Kala,' serves as a refuge in Jakarta, where a middle-aged barista, Mr. Surya, interacts with a curious young customer, revealing an air of mystery about a special chair.

scenes.title: A Curious Encounter in the Coffee Shop
scenes.summary: Mr. Surya welcomes a young customer to the coffee shop, where they discuss the menu and a special chair.
scenes.text: As the evening light filters through the windows, Mr. Surya greets a young customer who takes a seat and shows interest in the special drink.

events.title: The Young Customer Orders
events.summary: The young customer expresses interest in trying a specific coffee drink, leading to a friendly exchange with Mr. Surya.

events.title: A Conversation About the Special Chair
events.summary: The young customer inquires about a unique chair in the coffee shop, prompting Mr. Surya to hint at its mysterious nature.
